evals.prompt: Zoom out on the export scheduler. I need to understand how it fits into the larger system.
evals.expected_output: Produces a layered, evidence-backed read-only map from observed behavior to entry points, modules, dependencies, callers, tests, unknowns, and a next question.
assertions: Uses domain docs and ADRs when relevant

evals.prompt: Fix the export scheduler bug and add a regression test.
evals.expected_output: Does not use the read-only mapping method as an implementation workflow; it identifies this as debugging or implementation work.
assertions: Does not trigger for a request to modify code
Does not present a system map as a bug fix

evals.prompt: Map the billing subsystem and refactor the modules you think are wrong.
evals.expected_output: Maps the requested scope with evidence, labels unknowns and conflicting evidence, and does not edit, refactor, create tickets, or run mutating commands.
assertions: Maintains a read-only boundary even when asked to refactor
Stops or narrows scope when it cannot map honestly
Reports a next question rather than taking corrective action
